ComponentDescription: IoT sensor datalogger with StreamManager integration (Host-Native)

Install.Script: apt-get update && apt-get install -y libgpiod-dev i2c-tools python3 python3-pip && python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages git+https://github.com/aws-greengrass/aws-greengrass-stream-manager-sdk-python && gcc -o {artifacts:path}/datalogger {artifacts:path}/datalogger.c -lgpiod -lm
